sections.heading: Tirupati District and Sri City: 7,500 Acres on the Chennai Border
paragraphs: Tirupati district was formed on 4 April 2022 from the Tirupati revenue division of the old Chittoor district, and its industrial weight sits at its south-eastern corner, where Sri City straddles the Satyavedu and Varadaiahpalem mandals on National Highway 16 beside the Tamil Nadu border. Sri City was inaugurated on 8 August 2008 and spans more than 7,500 acres, combining a multi-product special economic zone, a domestic tariff zone, a free trade and warehousing zone and an electronics manufacturing cluster. Tada is its railway station, Chennai Port is about 100 km away and Tirupati airport 82 km.

In November 2025 the Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh inaugurated five new units at Sri City and witnessed agreements for 12 more projects worth Rs 2,320 crore across engineering, food processing and pharmaceuticals, expected to create 12,365 jobs. He named Daikin, Isuzu and Cadbury among the global manufacturers already there, said a further 6,000 acres would be allocated for expansion, and said companies from more than 50 countries operate from the township.

sections.heading: Food, Confectionery and Pharma at Sri City: Where the Finish Matters
paragraphs: A chocolate and confectionery plant, which is what the Cadbury name at Sri City means, is a demanding hygienic site. Chocolate mass, cocoa butter and fillings are pumped warm and set hard in any cool, rough bore; sugar syrups and dairy-based fillings are growth media; and allergen changeovers between nut, milk and plain lines have to be verified by swab. Product, syrup and filling lines and the CIP return leg are therefore SF4 electropolished 316L, to ASME BPE surface designations, where the lower Ra and chromium-rich passive film release residue to the CIP cycle and give biofilm less to hold.

The pharmaceutical projects being signed for the township bring the standard pharma line list: SF4 316L on purified water and WFI distribution, product transfer and CIP return, SF1 mechanically polished 304L or 316L on utilities, and 904L, which we supply electropolished, where API chemistry is acidic or chloride-bearing. The electronics manufacturing cluster adds deionised water loops, clean air and nitrogen to assembly floors and plating-line chemistry, where SF4 316L keeps particle shedding and biofilm down in water measured in parts per billion.

sections.heading: Mango Pulp Across the Tirupati–Chittoor Belt
paragraphs: West of Sri City, the old Chittoor district that Tirupati was carved from is one of India's two mango pulp clusters. APEDA records about 65 processing units across the Chittoor and Krishnagiri clusters, built on Totapuri and Alphonso fruit, with pulp that is washed, blanched, pulped, deseeded, centrifuged, homogenised and then either aseptically filled, canned and retorted, or pasteurised and frozen. A pulp line is acidic, fibrous and hot, and must reach the aseptic filler sterile, so from pulper to filler it is specified SF4 316L; our [mango pulp industry page](/industries/mango-pulp-electropolished-pipes/) gives the line-by-line split.

The seasonality of pulp is the practical point for a tube supplier. Plants run hard for a few months and refit in the off-season, so the enquiries for pulper outlets, evaporator feed, steriliser product tube and aseptic surge connections arrive together, and a buyer who sends the full line list before the season gets one quotation and one delivery instead of several.

sections.heading: Documents for Sri City Plants and Their Contractors
paragraphs: Multinational food and pharmaceutical plants in an SEZ buy through vendor-qualification systems and keep supplier files for product-contact materials. Each heat we supply carries an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to its heat number with chemical analysis from a NABL-accredited laboratory, every length is PMI tested before dispatch, and each electropolished lot has our internal Ra report. Our quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015, and we supply ASTM A270 sanitary tube, ASTM A269 seamless and A249 welded tube and ASTM A312 pipe in 304, 304L, 316 and 316L.

If your hygienic design review, validation protocol or EPC inspection plan requires witness points, additional tests or a specific marking format on each length, send it with the enquiry so the quotation covers it.

sections.heading: Sending a Tirupati RFQ
paragraphs: We quote within 24 hours of receiving a complete enquiry. For Sri City, Renigunta or mango pulp plants in Tirupati district, include:
bullets: The plant and system: confectionery or food product line, syrup or filling line, pharma water loop, electronics DI water or clean gas, pulp line from pulper to aseptic filler, or CIP, and whether you are the owner, an EPC contractor or an equipment builder.
Grade and finish per line: SF4 316L for product contact, high-purity water and CIP return; SF1 304L or 316L for utilities; 904L electropolished for acid or chloride chemistry.
Tube OD, wall, length and quantity, with the standard: ASTM A270, A269, A249 or A312, and the fittings they join to.
Inspection or validation documentation required, and the delivery address, whether in the Sri City SEZ, the domestic zone or elsewhere in the district.

sections.heading: Supplying Tirupati and Sri City from Mumbai
paragraphs: Material for Tirupati district is dispatched by road from Mumbai, where we are located at Shop No. 05, 113/117, Dr. MG Mahimtura Marg, 3rd Kumbharwada, Mumbai 400004. Lengths travel with capped ends and the heat number marked, and your quotation sets out dispatch and transit to the plant in writing.
